_meta.tweak_via: edit this file + commit; the retention job reads it on the next tick (no service reload needed)
_meta.rationale: Retention window for chain_events bookkeeping rows (session_start/session_done and other plumbing types). These never get read_at set, so they grow the table unbounded (~3,200 rows on 2026-06-02). Default 14d is conservative; intended to become Pulse-Check self-optimizing per the Check III/VIII pattern (analyzer proposes a window, Larry approves, Forge writes this file) rather than hand-pinned long-term. DECISION event types (approval_request, clarify_request) are NEVER deletable — the job hard-excludes them regardless of what this list says.
